surface.workspace: Inbox workspace is inert behind a scrim; stale Scratch remains non-interactive context
surface.icons: none; exact text, progress geometry, and focus treatment are the non-color cues

copy.running_search_empty: No matching Scratch is visible. Clearing the selection in {seconds} seconds.
copy.running_inbox_empty: No active Scratches remain. Opening the empty Inbox in {seconds} seconds.
copy.paused_search_empty: Movement paused. No matching Scratch is visible; the selection will clear.
copy.paused_inbox_empty: Movement paused. No active Scratches remain; the empty Inbox will open.
copy.draft_explanation: These drafts exist only on this page and will not move with the Scratch.

timing_and_state.announcement: announce lifecycle, timing, and destination once on entry and a changed destination once; never announce each tick
timing_and_state.pause: freeze exact remaining time and progress width
timing_and_state.terminal_validation: revalidate lifecycle and destination immediately before automatic or explicit movement

draft_copy.presentation: one source-labeled card per untruncated selectable full draft
draft_copy.success_effect: replace only the triggering card action with Copied
draft_copy.copy_rejected: keep Copy full draft, preserve focus, emit no false success, and leave the full selectable text available

focus.containment: focus remains within the alertdialog; Escape does not dismiss
focus.copy_success: preserve triggering Copy full draft button focus
focus.archive_restore: restore the pre-transition target when it survives, otherwise Scratch title Edit

theme_mapping.tiny-desk: wood frame, paper notice, ruled drafts, ruled-line countdown, stationery actions
theme_mapping.neumorphism: named inset panel/track and raised draft/action shadow roles
theme_mapping.claymorphism: sculpted panel, inset progress groove, raised actions, shape-led draft separation
theme_mapping.origami: folded paper panel, seam track, faceted draft sheets, asymmetric controls
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven editor frame, block progress, framed records, text command controls
theme_mapping.retro-mac: striped title bar, 1-bit double frame, hard segmented progress, pane drafts, square controls
theme_mapping.graphite: editorial notice, fine-rule track, ruled draft blocks, restrained monochrome actions

decision.restore: authoritative archive restore alone cancels the transition and retains selection plus page-memory drafts; hard delete has no restore path

exact_release.consumption_condition: Task 106 user checkpoint accepted; its plan marker remains open until then
